notes.title: Hanako Games news
notes.notes:
As of the beginning of this month, A Little Lily Princess is now published and available for multiple consoles, including handheld versions if you enjoy carrying your games that way. The game is the same; only the achievements had to be adjusted slightly.

If you're interested in cute games with raising sim aspects, our upcoming project Cute Bite (which is about a little vampire and her loyal butler) now has a limited-time free preview available as part of Steam Next Fest. Can you build the vampire's skills and help her regain her powers?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1586960/Cute_Bite/

It is also a light-yuri title: romance is completely optional and requires extra work to unlock, but all characters are female.

This demo version will only be available in June 2021, so check it out and wishlist now!

notes.title: Yuri Bundle Discount
notes.notes:
We've set up a special offer for our two yuri-centric games, A Little Lily Princess and Black Closet, so if you own one you can buy the other at a discount. 

While very different in gameplay and overall style, both games feature a female protagonist and a cast of female characters to get closer to.

At the moment, this is a test (we haven't done bundling before) so it may not stick around. However, if it goes well, then any future yuri-only titles will also be added to the bundle to make it easier to collect them all.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Black Closet Dev Releases A Little Lily Princess
notes.notes:
A childhood in the hands of Hanako Games can be filled with love and joy, but is always perilous. Long Live the Queen can make decisions like avoiding PE class into deadly mistakes, and procedural detective procedural Black Closet exposes teens to something far more vicious – a private girls’ school. Hanako’s latest, A Little Lily Princess [official site], sends a spoiled girl to boarding school and maybe this time it’s fine. You can make friends and study and whatnot, and that sounds good, doesn’t it?

I’m sure this picture of a scullery maid hanging from a roof simply shows a jovial prank.

… [visit site to read more]
